rows.en: Perfect timing. Come to the "Item Lab" right away. We'll talk there.
Nemo! What's wrong!?
There's something here!
There's a gash here, as if something slashed at it.
A trail of blood leads off to the north...!
This Ride Vendor seems to be broken.
Fighting the Weather Dopant like this is too risky! Let's go back to base and make a plan.
Step into the gate-like device?
The power is out. Looks like we need to work a switch somewhere.
...!! Someone's there...
No! Going back is too dangerous!
There's something here!
I'm looking forward to the Ride Machine being finished. How far along is construction?
Baraj is around here, right? Let's grab the Blue Stone of Baraj and head back already.
There's something here!
What's wrong? Hurry, get inside!
There's something here!
I know you guys will storm the enemy's stronghold and bring it down for sure!
It doesn't seem to be locked, but it won't open... Looks like we'll have to come back later.
Chains and what look like shackles are scattered across the floor...
Scalpels and what look like surgical tools have been left lying around.
Suspicious creatures are writhing in the water tank.
Blood and claw marks are left on the walls.
The smell of burning and chemicals stings the nose.
Broken lab equipment is scattered about...
There's someone up ahead!!
There's someone up ahead!!
Looks like up ahead... we'll come out in another area with a cross.
Looks like there's no way but forward...

An Alien Icarus corpse lies abandoned! ...For some reason, both its ears had been cut off.
A Zgok corpse lies abandoned! But the Iron Nails on both its arms were gone.
There's something up ahead!
Looks like you need to get a little closer to use the "Magnerium Medicalizer".
There's something here!
There's something here!
There's something here!
Nothing is on display. Looks like it's still being prepared.
Nothing is on display. Looks like it's still being prepared.

Nothing is on display. Looks like it's still being prepared.
Nothing is on display. Looks like it's still being prepared.
I hear something...!! It's coming from up ahead...
That field is gone, so we can move forward now.
There really was an underground level, but there doesn't seem to be a Gaia Gate around here.
We're underground... There must be a Gaia Gate somewhere.
Countless gashes are left on the walls. Someone must have fought fiercely here...
There's something here!
Hey! We're hitting the particle cannon from outside, right!? The Ride Gate isn't that way, is it?
"We're out of time!! Hurry!!"
"Where are you now!? You can check the particle cannon's location on the MAP!"
No good...! The particle cannon is surrounded by walls we can't break.
"High-Energy Reading Site" has been marked on the MAP.
There's something here!
Inside the capsule appears to be a kaijin.
Inside the capsule appears to be a kaiju.
Inside the capsule appears to be a mobile suit.
There's something here!!
Take a left there.
Once you're through the bulkhead, take another left right away.
After that, just follow the path! Hurry!!
The next one's the last bulkhead! Push straight through!!
How's Seravee doing? Go check on the Terminal Unit for me.
How's Seravee doing? Go check on the Terminal Unit for me.
There's something here!
There's something here!!
The door's open!!
Belial is further in... Be very careful.
You sense the presence of a fearsome enemy...
You sense the presence of a powerful enemy in this area...
You sense the presence of a powerful enemy...
You sense the presence of a powerful enemy in this area...
Cannot be learned yet.
Sold the items that couldn't be carried.
What's wrong? Hurry, get inside!
I know you guys will storm the enemy's stronghold and bring it down for sure!

notes.note: Legacy row (appears twice): second kanji of the verb is mis-decoded; read as nigekomu (flee inside), per the caller's hint.
Legacy row (appears twice); same meaning as an existing ally line about storming the enemy stronghold, voiced with rough omae-tachi.
Source has a mis-decoded kanji for 'smell' (not flagged legacy); read as smell from context.
Stray comma after 'water tank' in source ignored.
Cross inscriptions 0344-0354 keep a deliberate two-line layout with the full hero name in quotes on line 2 (00 Gundam, Wing Gundam Zero, Kamen Rider 1, Kamen Rider Black RX).
Inanimate 'something is here' rendered the same as the animate variant, matching earlier 'There's something here!!' for the double-bang form.
Quoted map-label term coined as "High-Energy Reading Site"; earlier dialogue calls it the high-energy spot.
Uses 'fearsome' for kyouretsu-na teki to distinguish it from the plain 'powerful enemy' (kyouteki) lines.
Speaker unknown; Nemo is the Gundam-side grunt suit, written 'Nemo' as in the earlier direct address.
0664-0667 are directions, probably over the radio though not in brackets; left unquoted as in source.

report: 87/87 rows (0226 and 0249 appear twice). Guessed legacy 0226 (flee inside). Coined map label 'High-Energy Reading Site' (0633). Zgok/Iron Nail and particle cannon taken from existing corpus; no new names.
